units.rawText: Of course we're friends. You gave me so much chocolate and treated me so well. How could we not be friends?

units.rawText: I could close one eye to you before the Arche Pyr was lit, but it's burning now.

units.rawText: You really are amazing to have done something that the Helios Sector tried for so long to accomplish but never did. For that, I truly respect you.
